newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain seeks effective labour reform - Folgado.
newsitem.headline: Spain seeks effective labour reform - Folgado.

text.p: Spain wants unions and employers to achieve effective labour reform based on consensus even if the deal does not meet all the objectives, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Monday.

"It is preferable that the two parties forge an agreement of 80 percent, rather than one based on a law that fulfils 100 percent which generates social problems," Folgado told Reuters in an interview.
According to Folgado, the government would prefer an agreement between the two parties, but it is prepared to step in if they don't reach an accord.
